preconditions.expression: n >= 2 and m >= n and m <= 200000
preconditions.description: The number of intersections n is at least 2, and the number of roads m is between n and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road is a one-way connection between two distinct intersections within the valid range.
All roads are distinct and exactly m roads are provided.
The path length k is at least 2 and at most n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= n for p in path) and len(path) == k and len(set(path)) == k
preconditions.description: The path consists of k distinct intersections within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all((path[i], path[i+1]) in roads for i in range(k-1))
preconditions.description: Each consecutive pair of intersections in the path is connected by a one-way road.

postconditions.description: The minimum and maximum number of rebuilds are non-negative, with max_rebuilds not less than min_rebuilds.

postconditions.expression: min_rebuilds == min(calculate_rebuilds(path, roads, shortest_paths) for shortest_paths in all_possible_shortest_paths(path, roads))
postconditions.description: The minimum number of rebuilds is the smallest possible across all valid shortest-path choices by the navigator.

postconditions.expression: max_rebuilds == max(calculate_rebuilds(path, roads, shortest_paths) for shortest_paths in all_possible_shortest_paths(path, roads))
postconditions.description: The maximum number of rebuilds is the largest possible across all valid shortest-path choices by the navigator.
